cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: I Need Your Blessing
cards.instruction: Get approval from someone whose opinion still carries emotional weight, even when permission is unnecessary.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Mum, we've signed the lease. Pick up your glass, please; I'd like a proper toast to our new home.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You don't need my permission to move in with Sam.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The lease is signed; that part is finished. I'm asking you to celebrate it. We start with the good wishes, please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm pleased for you. I'm still getting used to Sam.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Include Sam by name, Mum. Raise the glass to both of us in our home. Please don't make me supply half the toast myself.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 proper toast, A3 completed lease and good-wishes order, and A5 name inclusion direct professional-style celebration toward meaningful maternal blessing.

heightening.evidence: B4 pleased-for-you limitation causes A5 named two-person toast rather than generic thanks.

brevityWit.evidence: A5 exact inclusion and request not to supply missing half both press Mum to voice the blessing herself.
